output.reason: The linked PR [ev-1f55107536ea] says what changed: ksonnet apps were deleted from the argocd-example-apps repo, which made the ksonnet e2e tests fail, so those apps were removed from the e2e tests. The release-note line [ev-60daa9bc529f] agrees.
